text: The project is unique in its dual-MDB support structure, with both the World Bank and ADB financing distinct components under a common provincial program. It is implemented by SPHF, a dedicated Section 42 public limited company, which allows for focused governance and operational flexibility. The initiative is guided by a comprehensive set of publicly disclosed safeguards frameworks, including an Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF), a Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF), and a Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP).

metadata.solution_name: Sindh Floods Emergency Housing Reconstruction Project (SFEHRP)
